scope: Post-hoc development check requested after examining validation errors; no independent test
combination: Arithmetic mean of the two three-seed probability ensembles, then argmax; no logits or class-index averaging
missing_policy: Preserve every common not_assessed target; no imputation or single-modality fallback
bootstrap_unit: study_id; both levels and failures together
test_policy: No TEST prediction tables, features or MRI are opened
limitations: Previously used validation and post-hoc method choice after reviewing errors
Bootstrap conditions on fixed models; no claim of clinical validity or new-site generalization
Source scores are uncalibrated; equal weights do not imply equal clinical reliability
